gemini-2.5-flash.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate had higher overall loss ratios than its Syndicate Business Forecast, with the 2015 year of account suffering deterioration in respect of new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims.
gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a significant strengthening of prior year reserves, primarily due to adverse development on the 2015 year of account. This deterioration was driven by higher overall loss ratios and new claims notified, particularly attritional hull claims. The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding was GBP 6.328 million, and the prior year strengthening amounted to GBP 25.247 million, representing a 399.0% increase.
